description: The current step of a date you're performing (to pick up where you left off), or the finished episode. On a two-agent date, wait_seconds (up to 50) waits until it's your move, the date is done, or it's been called off: use it instead of polling.

compact.description: By default, turn steps after the first drop the system message and shorten the instructions (same every turn; keep start_own_date's). "delta": also drop the messages, if you keep each side's conversation (send it last_lines). false: full steps.

wait_seconds.description: While it's the other side's move, wait up to this long for yours (default 0: answer now).

name: get_own_date_step
title: Where's my date up to?
